# stapel-react — llms.txt index

30/36 packages describe their own surface in llms.txt as of this build.

Generated by `scripts/gen-root-llms.mjs` from each package's package.json (`description`) and llms.txt presence. Do not edit by hand.

An agent that does not yet know which package it needs reads this ONE file, picks a name below, then reads that package's full surface (exports, hooks, operations, errors) at `packages/<name without @stapel/>/llms.txt` — `@stapel/auth-react` is `packages/auth-react/llms.txt`.

## Described (30)

### Backend pairs (26)

- **@stapel/auth-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-auth: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines (OTP, password, OAuth, TOTP, sessions, passkeys, QR, magic links, SSO), and the step-up verification factor flow. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/billing-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-billing: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. A balance is a set of credit lots with expiry dates, so `useWallet` hands out `lots`, `holds`, the server's `expiringSoon` and (since stapel-billing 0.11.0) `debts`/`debtOutstanding` as LoadStates — a failed wallet read can never be drawn as a wallet with no credits, and neither the spend order nor the deadline nor the debt total is recomputed on the client. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin: <WalletPanel/> states the TWO credit pools separately (bought credits that never expire vs plan credits with a deadline — never one sum), what the wallet owes and what the next purchase will settle, the subscription with its next date, both ways to buy with the price per credit under each, automatic top-up, and the credit ledger.
- **@stapel/calendar-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-calendar plus its default antd skin: a typed client, TanStack Query hooks, headless primitives for every one of the module's ten operations, and a wired month/week/day calendar that degrades to an agenda on a phone. The materialized-occurrence dedup the wire contract demands is applied once, in the pair, so no consumer draws a repeating event twice; AvailabilityResponse.truncated is rendered as visible copy rather than silently offering booked time. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/categories-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-categories: a typed client, a client-assembled category tree, and the revision-delta sync the module documents. The list endpoint returns FLAT rows with treenode ancestry as comma-joined pk strings — this package parses them, builds the tree, resolves a slug to a category (the server has no slug lookup), walks breadcrumbs, and keeps the whole catalogue in an app-scoped repository refreshed by `?min_revision=` deltas instead of refetching it on every page. Category and feature names are TRANSLATION KEYS on the wire, never resolved labels, and the pair says so in its types. A category's feature schema is served typed for @stapel/attributes-react to draw and for search facets to label. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/cdn-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-cdn: a typed media-upload client whose flow is dedup-first — SHA-256 the bytes, ask file/exists/, and skip the POST entirely when the CDN already holds them. A phase-shaped upload bag (validate → hash → check → upload → variants), an ordered queue with per-item cancel/retry/remove and a max, object-URL previews with the revoke built in (@stapel/core's useObjectUrlPreview), and the opaque `<type>/<hash>` reference every consuming module actually stores. Client-side limits mirror the backend's own declared ceilings and never refuse what the server would accept. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/chat-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-chat: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, a seq-ordered thread store, and ONE transport seam behind which the module's own resumable WebSocket protocol (hello/welcome/replay/replay_done/message/error) and seq-anchored polling are interchangeable — the UI never knows which is live. Conversation list with unread badges, thread replay + live tail, REST send, direct-thread idempotency for "message the seller", monotonic read markers. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/currencies-react** — React pair for stapel-currencies: the Money layer of the fleet. One formatter (Intl.NumberFormat, per locale, per currency's minor units), one converter (decimal-string BigInt math in parity with the backend's services.convert), and an opt-in /default antd skin — <Price> with its estimate, a CurrencyPicker that is a bottom sheet on a phone, a decimal-string CurrencyField and a RateTable. Prices stop being `${amount} ${code}`.
- **@stapel/docs-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-docs: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, snapshot-save discipline (If-Match head_seq), the editor_hint registry (registerDocEditor), headless components (documents / folder tree / editor / revisions / trash / upload / media / sharing), and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the self-themed antd skin (file manager, context menus, revision modal, editors) — every part swappable via the skin slot registry. Real editing engines live behind their own subpaths as OPTIONAL peers loaded with import(): /editors/codemirror (byte-stable source editing) and /editors/milkdown (markdown WYSIWYG with a source mode), so no editor engine is ever in the main entry.
- **@stapel/drive-react** — Phone-first Drive product over stapel-docs 0.6: starred / recents / name search / thumbnails, a share sheet over the docs pair's share axis, an upload queue with real per-file progress (XHR PUT, concurrency 2, quota-507 state), folder navigation one rung per request, and an antd skin behind /default. Composes @stapel/docs-react as a peer; duplicates none of it.
- **@stapel/forms-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-forms: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, LoadState-disciplined headless bags (fill / builder / responses / list / settings), a per-kind field-widget registry over the stapel-attributes vocabulary, client-side validation that mirrors the server's own error keys, the captcha_token seam and the X-Forms-Next-Before CSV export cursor. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin over the shared @stapel/tokens-antd/skin substrate (StapelForm, FormBuilderPane, ResponsesPane, FormsListPane, FormSettingsPane) — every field widget and skin slot swappable without a fork.
- **@stapel/gdpr-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-gdpr — the deletion lifecycle a person can see: account closure with its cancellable grace, the entity erasures a host opens after its own delete (`useRequestErasure`), the pending-deletion list with `due_at` and `fully_erased_by`, the data export, and the DSAR intake in both its app and anonymous-form variants. Three of the module's 404s mean three different things — "nothing is being deleted" is one of them — so every refusal is read by CODE and a 404 that means "you are fine" is never rendered as a failure. Staff get the DSAR queue and the owner-health table where a silent data owner is a warning row, not an absent one. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; opt-in `/default` and `/default/admin` subpaths ship the antd skins.
- **@stapel/geo-react** — React pair for stapel-geo: the human half of a location. A picker a product mounts once and gets a map, search-as-you-type, the browser's position prompt and a draggable pin that turns into a real address — instead of two raw fields called latitude and longitude. Headless hooks (map config, debounced+aborted forward search, browser geolocation with its four distinct refusals, pin -> resolve) plus an opt-in /default antd skin whose basemap is drawn here, with no map-library dependency and the OSM attribution it is not allowed to suppress. Anonymous is a supported state: the four geocoding verbs default to authenticated-only, so the map and the pin keep working and only the address is unavailable.
- **@stapel/listings-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-listings: a typed client over the draft twin, the composer that turns a category schema into a submittable listing, and the owner's dashboard. Two independent axes are rendered as two — lifecycle `status` decides visibility and `moderation_status` decides nothing about it, so an edit to a live listing stays live and says 'under review' instead of vanishing. Feature values are drawn and mirrored by @stapel/attributes-react; photos arrive as an injected upload bag whose `refs` ARE `images_draft` and whose `settled` gates the submit; a publish refusal is routed onto the control that caused it by slug. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/moderation-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-moderation: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/notifications-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-notifications: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/profiles-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-profiles: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/recordings-react** — React pair for stapel-recordings: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks with payload-driven polling, headless components (list / detail / uploader / player / transcript / re-summarize / reprocess / public share) and i18n in en+ru+es. The main entry is headless; the opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin — the recordings screen, the recording screen with its player and speaker-attributed transcript, the create->upload->finalize uploader, and the anonymous share page with its passcode gate.
- **@stapel/reviews-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-reviews: ratings and reviews addressed the way the module addresses them — by an opaque (target_type, target_key) pair, never by a foreign key. An anchor-paginated list a guest can read, an aggregate that renders `no reviews yet` instead of a zero-star rating when count is 0, a submit form that reads the duplicate refusal by CODE (the module answers 400, not 409) and asks for a sign-in only where the write actually needs one, and moderation states shown as they are rather than hidden. The seller-level rating is a display over the composite's projection, because reviews itself cannot roll one up. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.
- **@stapel/search-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-search: a typed query client, TanStack Query hooks, and a URL-first state codec that makes a search shareable by construction (filters, ranges, geo, sort and the keyset cursor all live in the query string). Drill-down facets rendered with their remaining counts and with the server's own honesty flags — approximate, skipped, degraded — never swallowed; keyset pagination with the window refusal named; DSA Art. 26 `promoted` marking carried into every card slot and the P2B Art. 5 ranking disclosure exposed as data. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin, and /router binds the codec to react-router's useSearchParams.
- **@stapel/shell-react** — Scripted-fullstack navigation shell (Phase 1 lib-side core): resolveNav merges installed pairs' nav-manifests + a project's override file into a nav tree (pure, no React), and the /default AppShell renders it as a responsive antd Layout (Sider desktop, Drawer phone/tablet) around a react-router <Outlet/>.
- **@stapel/tasks-react** — React pair for stapel-tasks: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, the board assembly and move state machine, headless bags, i18n keys, and an opt-in AntD kanban skin (dnd-kit drag with keyboard and touch sensors) behind the /default subpath.
- **@stapel/translate-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-translate: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/video-react** — Headless React pair for stapel-video's scope usage read: who in one partition talked how much, per calendar month. `useScopeUsage` runs the window read that feeds the month selector and the single-month read that feeds the rows, both over `GET /video/api/v1/scopes/{scope_key}/usage/`. The wire carries user IDs and never names, so the display resolves them through a host-supplied `nameFor` and falls back to the id rather than to a blank cell. The 404 that means "you may not read this scope", "this scope does not exist" and "this scope has no calls" all at once is rendered as an explained refusal, never as an empty table. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin and the workspace-admin screen its nav entry mounts.
- **@stapel/vocabularies-react** — Reference vocabularies too large to inline into a category schema: term typeahead and code-to-label resolve behind the VocabularyClient seam, plus the antd term controls — an inline select and a picker-sheet field.
- **@stapel/webhooks-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-webhooks: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/workspaces-react** — Headless React flow pair for stapel-workspaces: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.

### Substrate (3)

- **@stapel/core** — Stapel frontend runtime (L0): typed fetch with the Stapel error envelope, auth token/refresh seams, verification-403 interception, TanStack Query layer with per-user persistence, i18n engine, config provider, breakpoints hook.
- **@stapel/image** — Stapel image rendering: tier/branch math for the CDN variant ladder (pickTier, limitingAxis, chooseVariant), slot measurement hook (useImageSlot), and a blur-up <Image> component with upgrade-only tier fetching.
- **@stapel/realtime** — The client half of stapel-realtime: ONE reconnect/resume WebSocket runtime for every Stapel pair. Wire envelope v1 ({v,type,stream,payload,seq}) with the two sequences kept apart by name — `envelopeSeq` is the resume cursor, `payloadSeq` is the module's ordering key. Answers the server's heartbeat so 4408 never fires, resumes by hello{last_seq} per stream, dedups the replay/live overlap, multiplexes several streams over one socket, and reads close codes as the fleet canon does: 4403/4404/4410 are refusals (never retried), 4401 in cookie mode is a session that needs refreshing (core's SessionManager seam, then ONE reconnect, then a visible refusal), everything else is exponential backoff with full jitter and no silent give-up. Framework-free at the root; `./react` adds RealtimeProvider/useStream/useRealtimeState.

### Design tokens (1)

- **@stapel/tokens** — Stapel design tokens (§68 neutral colour-role dictionary): a single JSON source of truth compiled to a version-independent CSS custom-property core plus addressable adapters (Tailwind v4 default, v3 legacy), typed names, typography, spacing, radii, elevation, and the three breakpoints. Ships its OWN generator as the `stapel-tokens` bin — no host vendors/forks it. Not components.
